issue_context.title: Add `projects::Toggle` command
issue_context.body:
### Check for existing issues

- [X] Completed

### Describe the feature

This would make it possible to use a single keybind for opening _and_ closing the projects menu, and make it consistent with other pickers as we already have `command_palette::Toggle`, `file_finder::Toggle`, `language_selector::Toggle`

### Environment

Zed: v0.164.2 (Zed)
OS: Linux X11 arch unknown
Memory: 62.5 GiB
Architecture: x86_64
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 with Max-Q Design || NVIDIA || 565.57.01

comments:
Can you clarify what do you mean by project's menu, maybe by screenshots?

Are you talking about the `projects::OpenRecent` action?
Yeah, I'm talking about the project picker, what you get by firing up `projects::OpenRecent` or `projects::OpenRemote`.
Maybe introducing `projects::ToggleRecent` and `projects::ToggleRemote` instead would work better.

> Maybe introducing `projects::ToggleRecent` and `projects::ToggleRemote` instead would work better.

Can you show a screenshot of what you mean for this? I am interested in taking this issue but want to make sure I understand what you want added for the command(s)?
Simply put, `projects::ToggleRecent` would show the recent projects panel if it's not already shown, and hide it if it is. The same applies for `projects::ToggleRemote`.
Hey @RPG-Alex , I was curious if you're still working on this issue or is it okay for me to join in?

@neunato I was inspecting the editor and how is what you want different than the default: `Ctrl+Alt+o` that opens the recent projects menu, and `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+o`? Sorry if I am misunderstanding but it seems to be built into Zed already.

> This would make it possible to use a single keybind for opening _and_ closing the projects menu

Open = press twice remains open
Toggle = press twice must close

> Yeah, I'm talking about the project picker, what you get by firing up `projects::OpenRecent` or `projects::OpenRemote`.

@neunato, just as @RPG-Alex, mentioned. I think this is already built into Zed. doing `Ctrl+Alt+O` opens the project menu for ya, listing the recent ones. Perhaps, you could elaborate on what you want `project::Toggle` to do.
